tagline: Designing judgment for the AI era.
hero_sub: We measure how AI describes your business,
and support the decisions and execution behind overseas expansion, new business and AI adoption.
hero_copy: Synapse Arrows is a consulting partner that thinks through your next step with you, and builds it with you.
org_description: A consulting company based in Singapore and Tokyo. It measures how AI describes a business and supports decisions and execution in overseas expansion, new business and AI adoption. Services: overseas expansion support, overseas expansion advisory, new business development, the AI visibility check (AI映え診断), corporate AI training and adoption, and AI agent development. It operates KanseiLINK, a third-party instrument for AI agents, and Linksee Memory, a memory MCP server.

aiaeo.title: AI visibility check (AI映え診断): plans and prices in English | Synapse Arrows
aiaeo.description: How AI describes your shop or company, checked against your official information. Free Light and detailed checks (in Japanese), then a fact-check report, re-measurement, monthly monitoring or an implementation retainer. Prices in JPY, tax excluded.
aiaeo.label: AI visibility check
aiaeo.intro_eyebrow: AI VISIBILITY CHECK / AI映え診断
aiaeo.intro_copy: We ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity about your shop or company, check every statement against your official information, and show you what to fix.
aiaeo.honest_h2: The free check is in Japanese and built for businesses in Japan.
aiaeo.honest_p: The free check looks at the directories and listing sites AI relies on in Japan, and its questions and industries are Japanese. That is why we have not translated the tool. If your business is in Japan, you can use it as it is; we can walk you through the result in English. For Singapore and other markets, please talk to us first.
jp_links: How it works after you apply (Japanese)
aiaeo.stages_h2: Two free stages first, then pay only if you need to.
stages: Whether AI can read your site, whether it links to the listing sites AI relies on, and whether your name, address, hours and menu are written in a way machines can read. It does not ask AI anything.
Three fixed questions, once each, on four AIs. One wrong statement is shown in full. If no wrong statements are found, you do not need a paid plan.
The fact-check report covers 20–30 questions, three runs each on four AIs. Re-measurement, monthly monitoring and fixes done by us are available after that.
aiaeo.plans_h2: From finding the problem to fixing it.
aiaeo.compare_h2: What you receive, and who makes the fixes.
aiaeo.compare_caption: Deliverables and scope of the paid plans
aiaeo.change_p: Fewer wrong addresses, prices, opening hours and menu items when AI describes you. We do not promise rankings or recommendations; the effect is shown by re-measurement.
fit: notice customers asking AI about your shop or company
moved, changed prices or menus, and AI still gives the old information
are listed on many directories and do not know which to fix first
nofit: want a guaranteed ranking in a short time
want to judge from a single AI answer
only want articles produced in bulk
aiaeo.who_p: Consultations, orders and paid work go through Synapse Arrows Pte. Ltd. The check runs on KanseiLINK (mcp.kansei-link.com), a third-party instrument we operate that measures whether AI agents can discover, connect to and use software. KanseiLINK ratings do not change with any contract.
aiaeo.dashboard: A dashboard is planned and not yet available. Monthly monitoring is delivered as a report.
aiaeo.next_p: We look at the detailed-check result with you and say which stage, if any, you need. Requesting materials alone is fine too.
aiaeo.prepay_h2: Monthly monitoring costs less when prepaid.
aiaeo.prepay_caption: How to pay for monitoring and the add-on (excl. tax)
aiaeo.option_p: The {name} adds {content} to monthly monitoring, at {price} excl. tax. Prepaid terms get the same discount on the add-on.
aiaeo.prices_basis: Several shops or a whole company: quote on request.
